title: Adolescent birth rate, Central and Southern Asia, by location
custodian: UN DESA Population Division and UNFPA
headline: Adolescent birth rate was higher in rural areas in 10 of 11 countries in Central and S. Asia
subtitle: The adolescent birth rate represents the risk of childbearing among females in a particular age group.
years: Latest surveys with both groups, 1996 to 2019; median gap 17.1 per 1,000.
data_line: Data: WHO Global Health Observatory via UN System Data Commons, indicator FERT_ADO, extracted 1 Nov 2026
alt: Adolescent birth rate was higher in rural areas in 10 of 11 countries in Central and S. Asia. Latest surveys with both groups, 1996 to 2019; median gap 17.1 per 1,000. Gap between rural areas and urban areas in 11 countries in Central and Southern Asia, ranked; 10 with rural areas higher, 1 with urban areas higher.
method: Method: gap within each country's latest survey with both groups.
question: Where have you seen the gap in adolescent birth rate between rural areas and urban areas close, and how was it measured?
